about: DATED MEASUREMENTS NO COMMITTED GATE CAN RE-RUN. The files they were taken on are client documents and are not in this repository, so a gate cannot repeat them; what a gate CAN do is refuse a count on a public page that no dated record states. Each record says what was measured, when, by whom and how, and how many real files were read and refused. A coverage row that cites a record prints THE RECORD'S counts (gate public-claims C4 compares them); to change a count, add a new dated record — never edit a number in coverage.json alone. Records name no company.

records.detail: Read-only dry run of the reprocess over the stored periods in production on 2026-10-01: two distinct real books whose source is a text-layer trial-balance PDF were read by the deterministic text reader (extraction method deterministic, no model call). Separately, one real text-layer PDF in the four-pair layout with blank zero cells is refused by the reader rather than read (measured offline on the file; first recorded 2026-09-26).

records.detail: The production parser run offline over every real 10-column trial-balance sheet held outside the repository: seven distinct sheets, six read (the count engineProof.json `formats` measures), one refused with "Couldn't find the column headers" — its header abbreviates Debit / Credit to D / C. Re-run on 2026-10-02 with the same result.
